thread:
Rina Shah: sharing a compact take on the on-prem network step: a single-line summary strip at the top that shows aggregated status + host count. figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-strip

Marco Li: looks promising. two quick asks: 1) show the worst-host state when multiple hosts are present (so folks see problems at a glance), 2) include a small chevron/action: `Hosts ▾` to open a flyout list.

Tess O'Neill: copy note: label options: `Connectivity summary`, `Network health`, `Connection overview`. prefer `Connectivity summary` — less technical for customers.

Lin Gomez: accessibility: the strip must be `role=status` and `aria-live="polite"` so changes are announced. include sr-only text "Connectivity summary: Degraded. Last checked 30s ago." Use icons + text; no color-only indicators.

Rina Shah: UX detail: when flyout opens show each host with short status + reason (max 2 lines). allow arrow key navigation and Enter to open host details. flyout should be closable with Esc.

Marco Li: implementational: `Retry all` on the strip triggers parallel lightweight probes. show spinner on the strip and update cached host results when done. debounce clicks for 10s.

Tess O'Neill: microcopy for degraded reasons (truncated): "Firewall blocking egress", "DNS lookup failed", "Registry auth denied", "High packet loss". will mock 3 variants for truncation.

Lin Gomez: keyboard behavior: strip focusable with tabindex=0; pressing Space/Enter opens the flyout. when status updates, announce but don't steal focus. add `aria-expanded` on the chevron button. flyout should use `role=listbox` and each host `role=option` with `aria-selected` when focused.

support-bot: FYI  diagnostics bundle endpoint available at `/api/support/diagnostics?hosts=<ids>` — will return a downloadable tar.gz.

Rina Shah: nice. UX question: should we expose a `Copy diagnostics` CTA on the host row or a single `Collect diagnostics` in the flyout footer? I lean toward per-host for quick share.

Marco Li: per-host CTA is fine but keep a compact secondary action `Copy` icon only. include tooltip `Copy diagnostics` and sr-only label for screen readers.

Tess O'Neill: accessibility copy tweaks: tooltip text should announce when copied: "Diagnostics copied to clipboard" as live region. also include fallback to download if clipboard blocked.

Lin Gomez: small aria spec I'll drop in the PR: `role=status aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"` on the strip, chevron has `aria-controls` pointing at flyout id, flyout `role=listbox`, options `role=option`. will include keyboard diagrams.

Rina Shah: deliverables for this round: 1) three header copy variants (Tess), 2) truncated reason samples (Tess), 3) aria spec (Lin), 4) Retry/Diagnostics API usage notes (Marco), 5) figma updates with per-host CTAs (me). will sync in tomorrow's design review. :rocket:
